diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 0.017 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: HC-SR04 datasheet (the RCWL-9610 'P' version keeps the same GPIO timing): "Test distance = (high level time x velocity of sound (340M/S) / 2" and "Formula: uS / 58 = centimeters". 340 m/s / 2 = 0.017 cm per us of Echo high time, i.e. 1/58.8. The model uses exactly this conversion in equivalent form: the driver divides the Echo pulse width by US_PER_CM = 58.3 (= 0.01715 cm/us, using 343 m/s at 20 degC, within 1% of 0.017), and part.json/buildNotes state 'distance cm = us / 58'. The gate reports 'none' only because the 'ultrasonic' sim kind expresses the conversion as echo timing (sim.echo) rather than a raw-count scale field; the formula itself agrees.
